decisions.statement: A property naming one here is unique within that property's value.
The property named here is declared on the same page type as the property naming it.
The property named here is required.
The property named here has one value.
Naming a property makes the unique kind `page-property` rather than `page-type`.
A property naming none is unique across the whole of the kind it states.

definition: the property whose value a unique value is unique within
